newsitem.title: USA: HNC Software Inc completes Retek buy.
newsitem.headline: HNC Software Inc completes Retek buy.

text.p: HNC Software Inc said on Monday it has completed its acquisition of Retek Distribution Corp, a privately held developer of merchandise-management software, in an all-stock deal valued at about $47 million.
Under the agreement, HNC will issue 1,367,196 shares of its common stock and 155,864 stock options to the shareholders and option holders of Retek.
HNC develops neural-network technology in client/server computer environments.
Retek customers include Hallmark, Tandy, Zales, Cracker Barrel, The Container Store and Sears UK.
